item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We must prevent its creation—not trust that we can contain something more capable than we are.

2. We will not get a second chance with superintelligent AI. Once a system can outthink humanity, our safeguards and institutions will no longer determine what happens next. We must act before control is permanently lost.

3. Our future must remain in human hands. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years would permanently surrender that future. We call for decisive action to prevent it from being built.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 107 words

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We state this plainly because the stakes demand honesty, not reassurance. A system more capable than humans across every consequential domain would outthink our institutions, overcome our safeguards, and determine outcomes we could no longer reverse. We would not get a second chance to correct the mistake. The decisions made now—about research, governance, and restraint—will decide whether we remain authors of our shared future. We therefore call for action strong enough to prevent superintelligent AI from being built, not merely promises to manage it after the fact.
